programs.title: Megatransporty
programs.desc: The team that is carrying the 200-ton reactor from Lithuania to Belarus has to face extremely difficult weather conditions.The main driver, Makuwa, faces snow-covered roads and cooperation with local pilots that leaves much to be desired.A team of specialist roadside assistance sets out to deal with the breakdown of a dump truck going to collect coal.He needs to unblock the narrow two-way road before it creates a traffic jam.After waiting for 24 hours at the border, Tomek, Ania and Mateusz enter Germany.However, they are forced to take a longer route, and the transport is interrupted by a failure of the trailer's lighting and controls.Finally, they come across a viaduct that is too low.
